PrepPilot AI Interview Project

Candidate: Docker Smoke Test
Target: AI Application Backend Intern

Skills
Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Vue, RAG, LLM API

Project Experience
Built an AI interview platform with FastAPI and asynchronous SQLAlchemy.
Implemented JWT access and refresh tokens, Redis verification codes, PDF resume
parsing, chunking and keyword retrieval. Designed an LLM provider abstraction
for Mock, DeepSeek and Ollama. Added Vue pages for resume upload, interview
practice and reports. Used pytest and Docker Compose to verify the full flow.

Testing

generation, answer scoring, follow-up questions and interview reports.
